description: All-step strict-positivity threshold and arithmetic near-singularity of direct Gaussian quadrature for the finite-time planar rank-one controllability Gramian.
integrity: Analytic proof in RESULT.md; finite deterministic standard-library checks in verify.py are supporting diagnostics only.
limitations: Two-dimensional damped rotational dynamics with fixed rank-one forcing.
Quadrature applies directly to the integral and is not Gauss Runge–Kutta applied to the matrix ODE.
Quantitative conditioning and normalized-error conclusions require zero damping.
Only the first four Gauss–Legendre orders are classified and no uniform conditioning is claimed.
Historical mathematical priority requires independent confirmation.
title: Four Gauss–Legendre Nodes Are the Minimal Resonance-Free Quadrature for a Planar Controllability Gramian
